mechanism_claims.claim_text: Ana-5 directly perturbs S. aureus membranes, supported by membrane depolarization, calcein leakage, and SEM morphology assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports membrane disruption for Ana-5 under tested assay conditions; it does not establish a single exclusive lethal target.
